items.passage: Amy likes sports. On Monday, she plays tennis with her friend. On Wednesday, she swims at school. She runs in the park every morning. Her brother plays baseball, and Amy likes soccer too. On the weekend, they watch basketball games on TV together.
items.advPassage: Last Saturday, Ken went to the sports center with his dad. First, they played tennis for an hour. Then Ken swam in the big pool. He was tired, so they ate sandwiches. In the afternoon, they watched a basketball game. Ken had a great day.
